name: ChangeLab external validity audit v1.1
status: v1 frozen at 4c9eb67; v1.1 data-only amendment after input validation rejected empty reference answers, before a completed scored run
data_amendment: Quarantine empty questions/answers and invalid gold evidence. Preserve different temporal contexts of a repeated question as correlated cases in one split; deduplicate exact question/time/context/answer records. This corrects the unit of deduplication without changing the core implementation or acceptance gates.
purpose: Try to falsify practical value; do not optimize the tool on evaluation outcomes.

ragtruth.role: Human-labeled real model outputs, task compatibility and semantic-check boundary
ragtruth.evaluation_split: official test; train is inventory/development only
ragtruth.unit: source_id, with six correlated model responses per source
ragtruth.semantic_label: at least one annotated span with implicit_true != true
ragtruth.quality_policy: good responses in primary metrics; report truncated/refusal exclusions
ragtruth.native_applicability: Do not invent answer citations or gold-text contracts for free-form answers. Unsupported task formats are unscored, not hallucinations.

timelyqa.role: External synthetic temporal-conflict stress; not real document history
timelyqa.unit: normalized query group, never a derived fault variant
timelyqa.split: grouped SHA-256 bucket: 0-69 development, 70-84 validation, 85-99 held-out test
timelyqa.duplicate_policy: Deduplicate normalized question/time/context/answer records; repeated questions with different contexts remain correlated cases in one numeric-masked query group. Report distinct raw rows, unique questions, contexts, and groups.
timelyqa.time_policy: Audit gold evidence dated after query; quarantine those rows from any as-of availability claim
timelyqa.license_policy: Do not redistribute third-party corpus text without an explicit dataset license

release_history.role: Human-authored real release snapshots; actual retrieval/evidence impact, no LLM quality claim
release_history.query_policy: Unique section-heading paths from baseline English docs, explicitly generated retrieval probes, not human QA
release_history.split: Source document family; before/after versions and sections stay together
release_history.ground_truth: Full retest change in top-k source IDs/content hashes; evidence-change coverage is not semantic regression recall

statistical_policy.uncertainty: 95% bootstrap intervals by source/query group, never by correlated variants
statistical_policy.no_global_average: Do not pool incompatible semantic, provenance, temporal, and scheduler tasks into one accuracy score

continuation_gates.semantic_claim: Cannot claim semantic correctness without a supported semantic verifier and externally labeled validation
continuation_gates.scheduler_claim: At least 20% median call reduction at >=95% evidence-change coverage on full real release updates; report any fallback and all unchecked cases
continuation_gates.independent_value: Must beat or materially simplify a plain reverse index / existing evaluation workflow
continuation_gates.deployment_claim: Requires actual model-backed LightRAG run; public replay and HTTP fixtures do not satisfy this gate

compute_policy: Use already available CPU libraries and public recorded outputs; do not silently replace a real LightRAG deployment with an extractive mock.
disclosure: No model/API credentials are currently configured; a model-backed LightRAG experiment remains a separately visible gap.
